reading_note: Taken ONLY from this document: Figure 1 (شکل ۱, pdf 15 / printed 6), Figure 2 (شکل ۲, pdf 20 / printed 11) and clauses 3, 5, 6. Items in Figure 1 are listed in the figure's right-to-left column order. The main characteristic names carry a letter footnote giving the English name (b Portability … l Functional suitability; for quality in use b Efficiency, c Effectiveness); letters a and m are legend markers («جدید» / «تغییریافته») and are unrelated to those footnote letters. term‌en is null wherever the document prints no English name — ISO/IEC 25010 names were NOT supplied from outside the document. «id» is a stable key (PQ = product quality, QU = quality in use); the clause where the item is described is in «clause». change‌for‌ai «unchanged» for inherited items = no a/m marker and no explanation in the document (inference from absence, see change‌basis).

ai_specific_summary.note: No main characteristic is marked a or m in either figure. Six distinct new sub-characteristics (transparency appears in both models) and one modified sub-characteristic are marked. Clause 5.1/6.1 additionally say some sub-characteristics have different meanings or contexts than in ISO/IEC 25010 and that these are explained in the clause; only 5.2-5.7 and 6.2-6.3 give explanations.
